title: Personality engineering with AI agents: A new methodology for negotiation research
abstract: arXiv:2605.20554v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: According to canonical negotiation theory, people's success in a negotiation depends on how well they balance competing demands--empathizing and asserting, demonstrating concern for other and concern for self, being soft on the people and hard on the problem. Yet people struggle to manage these tensions, so researchers have lacked the ability to rigorously test the field's prescriptions under controlled conditions. AI agents do not face the same limitations, and their precision, repertoire, consistency, and scalability enable a new class of experiments to contribute to negotiation theory. In this article, we introduce personality engineering--a methodology that precisely parameterizes the personas of AI agents based on established personality frameworks--and propose how this method can be used to study the traits and behaviors of human negotiators. translated_title: 基于AI智能体的人格工程：一种谈判研究的新方法论
translated_abstract: 根据经典谈判理论，人们在谈判中的成功取决于如何平衡相互竞争的需求——既要共情又要坚持主张，既要关注他人又要关注自我，既要对人温和又要对事强硬。然而，人们难以驾驭这些张力，因此研究人员一直缺乏在受控条件下严格检验该领域理论建议的能力。AI智能体不受同样的限制，其精确性、行为库、一致性和可扩展性使得一类新型实验能够为谈判理论做出贡献。在本文中，我们提出了“人格工程”这一方法论——基于成熟的人格框架对AI智能体的人格进行精确参数化——并提出如何利用该方法来研究人类谈判者的特质与行为。鉴于其与谈判理论的相关性，我们提出了人际环状模型……
tldr: 本文提出“人格工程”这一新方法论，通过基于成熟人格框架对AI智能体的人格进行精确参数化，实现了在受控条件下严格检验谈判理论，为研究人类谈判者的特质与行为开辟了新途径。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "personality engineering," a new methodology that precisely parameterizes the personas of AI agents based on established personality frameworks, enabling a new class of controlled experiments to rigorously test negotiation theory and study the traits and behaviors of human negotiators.
